call_points.text: Aunta-Simaria HAM divestment signed at ~₹1,000 Cr enterprise value; completion expected in Q2 FY27.
Pune-Shirur appointed date expected in Q3 FY27; revenue recognition of ~₹500 Cr expected this financial year.
Aunta-Simaria completion expected to reduce about ₹800 Cr of debt.
Q1 execution hit by Mumbai construction stoppage, geopolitical supply disruption and election-related labour migration.
Revised FDP for MB-OSN-2005/2 submitted; approval expected in 4-6 weeks, production about 2 years after approval.
Smart Ops revenue potential of ₹50-100 Cr, but no formal guidance given.
Guided full-year EBITDA margin at 18% plus, factoring in supply chain disruptions and geopolitical headwinds.
Pune-Shirur DBFOT project has an EPC cost of ~₹5,400 Cr; financial closure is expected in October or November.
The ₹1,000 Cr fundraise proposal is purely an enabling resolution with no immediate plans to raise capital.
Targeting monetization of Aunta-Simaria project within H1 FY27 after receiving the first annuity.
Welspun Michigan Engineers delivered ₹874 Cr revenue in FY26 (+31% YoY) with 21% EBITDA margin.
Geopolitical issues and supply chain disruptions pose near-term cost and execution challenges.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Welspun Sattanathapuram Nagapattinam Road Private Limited (a subsidiary of Welspun Enterprises Limited) is taking appropriate steps to file a detailed reply against each of the SCNs. The alleged difference is arising due to inaccurate reporting by our customer in the relevant Form GSTR-7 returns. The Company is of the view that the demands raised in the SCNs are without merits and are expected to be set aside during the adjudication proceedings. The Company does not foresee any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company.
tax_litigation.status: Out of the total proposed tax demand of Rs. 21,86,29,346/- in the SCNs dated 25.09.2025 (3 SCNs), the Adjudicating Authority has issued Orders confirming tax demand of Rs. 2,61,308/- along with applicable interest and penalty under Section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017. Without prejudice to the merits of the case, given the negligible quantum of the dues sought as per the Order, the Company has paid the applicable dues. Accordingly, the said litigation stands closed. The Company would like to mention that such dues does not have any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company.

tax_litigation.status: Out of the total proposed tax demand of Rs. 48,86,62,934/-, the Adjudicating Authority has issued Order confirming tax demand of Rs. 18,40,73,256 along with applicable interest and penalty under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017. The alleged difference on which tax demand is confirmed is due to incorrect values reported by the Customer in Form GSTR-7 filed for FY 2021-22 and hence, there is no short payment of tax. The Company has filed an appeal against the Order before the First Level Appellate Authority. The Company does not foresee any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company.

timeline.summary: Welspun Enterprises received [ICRA]AA (Stable) and [ICRA]A1+ credit ratings for its ₹400 Cr bank facilities from ICRA Limited.
Welspun Enterprises received a ₹7,300 Cr LoA from MSIDC for the Pune-Shirur highway DBFOT project, expanding its order book to ~₹18,755 Cr.
Welspun Enterprises incorporated Welspun Pune Shirur Projects Limited as a wholly-owned subsidiary with an initial capital of ₹1 lakh.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,199.46 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹144.69 Cr.
CRISIL Monitoring Agency report for Q4FY26 showed nil utilization of Welspun Enterprises' ₹250 Cr received from convertible warrants, with funds parked in mutual funds.
Welspun Enterprises Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call on May 15, 2026, for audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website.
Welspun Enterprises held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15-20% FY27 revenue growth and ₹8,000-10,000 Cr order inflows.
Welspun Enterprises subsidiary received ₹179.87 Cr GST show cause notices and penalty over client TDS reporting discrepancies across two states.

On August 5, 2026, Welspun Enterprises held its Q1 FY27 earnings call, reporting revenue of ₹774 Cr, EBITDA margin of 22.9%, an order book of ₹18,700 Cr and a signed agreement to divest the Aunta-Simaria HAM project at about ₹1,000 Cr enterprise value.
